Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished desktop Web UI reference image for Personal OS, landscape 4:3 approximately matching the supplied home reference. Full-bleed app screenshot, no browser/device frame, no multi-page collage. Reference image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER reference, not a request to retain its home-page content. Preserve recognizable Skadi the Corrupting Heart (浊心斯卡蒂) from Arknights, silver hair, red eyes, ornate ocean/gothic art and matching logo treatment. This is a general-purpose personal work operating system with a user-selected Skadi skin; 博士 is an optional personal nickname, not the product identity. Use restrained character artwork in header/right background/margins behind opaque enough readable content, rather than a huge home hero. Rich atmospheric illustration and beautiful material surfaces like the reference, not generic flat SaaS. Consistent app shell: narrow left sidebar Personal OS, navigation exactly 首页 Today / 任务 Tasks / 项目 Projects / 情报 Intelligence / 审核 Review / 历史 History, 设置 Settings at bottom. Global command bar at top '搜索任务、项目、历史，或创建任务…', small avatar. Clearly highlight current page. Use readable, carefully typeset simplified Chinese with small English subtitles; professional spacious hierarchy, consistent icons and alignment. Keep all navigation and content within frame. No Calendar, Notes, Gallery, habit-tracking or unrelated dashboard stats. Important: this is a functional INNER PAGE, not the home screen. 
Current page: 任务 Tasks.
Theme: Morning ocean sanctuary theme: silver-white, sea blue, teal, subtle gold; luminous sea and cathedral ruins, white birds, translucent pearl-white cards, fine gold/silver organic edging, tranquil light. Skadi in the white/teal outfit shown in morning reference.
